senses.sense_definition: A valve, tap, or faucet used to control or regulate the flow of water or another fluid.

examples.text: The plumber replaced the old <w>turncock</w> to stop water from leaking through the main pipe.
Make sure you shut off the <w>turncock</w> before beginning any repairs on the kitchen plumbing.

traits.comment: now largely superseded by tap, faucet, or stopcock

senses.sense_definition: A worker formerly employed by a water company to operate the water mains, regulate fireplugs, and control supply to districts.

examples.text: During the Victorian era, the <w>turncock</w> would walk the streets to regulate the municipal water supply.
The local residents sent for the <w>turncock</w> when the street mains failed to supply water.

traits.comment: refers to a historical municipal occupation
